stock.description: Yunnan Water Investment Co., Limited operates as an investment holding company, dedicated to the design, construction, development, operation, and ongoing maintenance of vital municipal water supply, wastewater, and solid waste treatment infrastructure. The company's reach extends throughout the People's Republic of China and internationally. Its business is structured around five primary segments: Wastewater Treatment, Water Supply, Solid Waste Treatment, Equipment Construction and Sales, and Other services. The company actively builds and manages projects for wastewater processing, water provision, and solid waste disposal. It also engages in Build and Transfer (BT) and Engineering-Procurement-Construction (EPC) contracts. Complementing its infrastructure development, the firm manufactures, markets, and installs specialized equipment for various environmental facilities. Additionally, it offers operation and maintenance (O&M) services for facilities owned by other entities, alongside technical and advisory consultancy. By December 31, 2021, Yunnan Water Investment's extensive operations included 134 concession wastewater treatment projects, encompassing models such as 7 build-own-operate (BOO), 69 build-operate-transfer (BOT), 2 transfer-own-operate (TOO), 27 transfer-operate-transfer (TOT), 1 rehabilitate-operate-transfer (ROT), and 28 municipal environment comprehensive treatment initiatives, with a total daily capacity of approximately 3,553,400 tonnes. The water supply portfolio featured 67 concession projects (15 BOO, 35 BOT, 11 TOT, and 6 municipal environment comprehensive treatment projects), capable of supplying around 2,449,100 tonnes daily. Furthermore, it managed 24 solid waste treatment facilities, processing an estimated 4,081,900 tonnes annually. The company had also completed 10 BT projects, undertaken 13 EPC projects, and overseen 26 O&M projects. Established in 2009 as Yunnan Water Industry Investment and Development Co., Ltd., the company rebranded to Yunnan Water Investment Company Limited in July 2014. Its corporate base is located in Kunming, People's Republic of China.

provenance.depreciation: Analyst EBITDA minus EBIT when nonnegative and both available; otherwise modeled TTM D&A/revenue. Analyst measure definitions are not independently certified.
provenance.riskFreeRate: User-directed USD Treasury proxy under the HKD/USD peg; not an observed HKD yield or a copied US-stock WACC
provenance.tax: TTM effective tax; scenario assumption, not a marginal-rate forecast
provenance.kd: TTM accounting interest / average reported debt; not a current financing quote
provenance.erp: 4.75% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.beta: FMP profile beta; lookback, frequency and benchmark unspecified by the response
provenance.terminalG: 2.25% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.cash: All reported cash and short-term investments assumed nonoperating; adjustable
provenance.investments: Long-term investments assumed nonoperating at book value; adjustable, not fair-value evidence
provenance.priority: Preferred and minority book values are adjustable value proxies; cost defaults to common Ke
provenance.leases: Cash-flow-matched debt reconciliation: liabilities whose payments remain in FCFF are not deducted again; financing treatment requires matching profit, depreciation and reinvestment adjustments
